name: relaticle
description: Open-source CRM your AI agents can read and update: companies, people, opportunities, tasks and notes. REST API, self-hosted or cloud.

latest_release.name: v3.9.2
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* fix(workspaces): require a verified email to join, decline or connect by @ManukMinasyan in https://github.com/relaticle/relaticle/pull/1168
* fix(records): check permission before linking tasks and notes from a record by @ManukMinasyan in https://github.com/relaticle/relaticle/pull/1169
* fix(sysadmin): keep plan changes on reset period to super administrators by @ManukMinasyan in https://github.com/relaticle/relaticle/pull/1170
* fix(custom-fields): refuse field changes after a member's role is lowered by @ManukMinasyan in https://github.com/relaticle/relaticle/pull/1171


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/relaticle/relaticle/compare/v3.9.1...v3.9.2
